name: cio_pages_lane_effect_enforcement_lq3156_20261114
comment: ANCHOR: LQ3156_LANE_EFFECT_ENFORCEMENT — CAMPAIGN-8H §5.3 for the cio-pages-product lane. Against the REAL
store_pg upsert and the REAL per-product pg_try_advisory_xact_lock on a disposable initdb cluster: (1) a
duplicate fire is SKIPPED_BUSY and builds/writes nothing; (2) a later legitimate refresh publishes (seq+1);
(3) an older admission against a VALID stored row is REFUSED_OLDER, the CLI exits 3, the build log gets the
FAILED row with detail.receipt_outcome=REFUSED_OLDER, and the stored row is untouched. IsolatedPostgres only:
no live store, no Valkey, no lane, no cron, no unit.
